title: Chromium browser profiles (Snap install)
whyItMatters: The Snap build of Chromium keeps browsing history, sessions, bookmarks, cookies and saved logins in the snap folder instead of ~/.config/chromium, so a scan of the normal location alone sees nothing.
source: Chromium user data directory docs plus Snap confinement: the Snap user data dir is ~/snap/chromium/common/chromium, and each profile is a subfolder with a Preferences file: https://chromium.googlesource.com/chromium/src/+/main/docs/user_data_dir.md
notes: Matches the Preferences marker so non-profile folders such as Crash Reports are skipped. Ubuntu's Chromium is a Snap since 20.04. Some older installs put the Default profile under ~/snap/chromium/current/.config/chromium; current is a symlink and is not followed.

cleanup.exportFirst: In Chromium, export your bookmarks from the bookmark manager and your passwords from the password manager, and keep both files off this computer.
steps: Uninstall the Chromium snap from the App Center or with the Snap Store app.
Move the folder named in the plan to the Trash and empty the Trash.
cleanup.risk: Removes every Chromium profile in the snap folder: history, bookmarks, saved passwords, cookies and extensions. No online copy exists.
